_note: Tranche 1: preset names for everything outside the PvE job groups - PvP, Bozja, Variant/Deep Dungeon, gathering and the cross-role ALL group. Ability, status and duty-action names use the official German client wording from tools/GameGlossary. 'Burst' is left as Burst throughout: in Wrath's text it means the rotational burst window, not the game's status of that name, which the glossary renders 'Schub'. "Wardens Paeon Option" is left untranslated because that ability no longer exists in the game's sheets, so its German wording cannot be verified.
